# Public APIs DSH reference package

Language: English.

Registers the `public-api-selection` reference Skill. It grants no tools and includes no upstream code, documentation, data, examples, or assets. See the [locale guide for installation, start, verification, invocation, update/restart, disable/stop distinction, and removal](https://github.com/tonulls/dsh-plugins/blob/tonulls/dsh-%5Bname%5D-tonulls/dsh-public-apis-tonulls/.docs/en/guide/setup.md) and [UPSTREAM.json](UPSTREAM.json).

## Automatic selection

Automatic selection is off by default for each Agent. Use `/dsh-public-apis-tonulls on` and `/dsh-public-apis-tonulls off`; direct Skill invocation remains available.
